results.title: Chris Murphy: Trump's Control Over GOP Will Hurt Them in Midterms Over Iran War
results.description: Senator Chris Murphy (D-CT) predicts that Republican senators in traditionally red states will lose their seats in the midterm elections due to their continued support for the Iran war, which is unpopular and seen as a failure. He criticizes the GOP for blindly following Trump's instructions rather than acting as an independent political party, highlighting the rise of drone warfare as a key factor in the conflict's outcome.

results.title: Navratri 2026: What to Prepare on Day 1 Before Kalash Sthapana
results.description: Shardiya Navratri 2026 begins on October 11 with Kalash Sthapana and the worship of Maa Shailputri. Devotees can prepare for the first day by arranging essential puja samagri, cleaning the worship area, preparing traditional bhog and keeping the Goddess's mantra ready. This guide covers the important items, basic preparations and the need to check the locally applicable Ghatasthapana muhurat.
